scores.reasoning: Frost Prime has a single ability that deals heavy damage (Ice Wave), but it lacks other abilities to provide support or crowd control.
Frost Prime has a passive that increases the duration of cold status effects and an ability (Snow Globe) that grants temporary invulnerability, but these are not strong survivability features.
Frost Prime has no abilities designed to support allies or provide utility in a team setting.
